messages:
toni (Design): quick review request 1: updating Compliance > Encryption region picker. want clearer labels for key ownership and a short helper that ties to audit behavior. mock attached. looking for short copy + a11y + keyboard notes.

mohit (Product): prefer labels that non-technical folks can read quickly. suggestion: show "Redwood-managed key" and "Customer-managed key (bring your own)". preselect account default region.

kevin (Eng): implementation note: custom combobox (aria pattern) with native select fallback. helper text must be referenced with aria-describedby (not inside listbox). add aria-live status that announces: "Region set to eu-west-1; using customer-managed key; audit will record key reference."

samir (Security): avoid saying just "key id": use "key reference" in UI and audit entries. helper copy should state: "Audit logs record region and key reference for requests using customer-managed keys." add modal text clarifying key material never leaves customer control.

allegra (PM): UX: if BYOK not configured show option disabled with tooltip: "Requires an uploaded key and permissions 1 see docs". keep option visible so teams discover capability.

a11y-bot: quick checklist: combobox/role pattern, aria-activedescendant updates with keyboard nav, aria-describedby present on the control, aria-live updates on selection, focus ring visible, badges include icon not color-only, contrast >= 4.5:1. manual review required.

toni (Design): thanks 1 will update mock: short labels, helper tied to aria-describedby, disabled tooltip copy, confirmation modal copy (with 2min propagation note), icons + color not sole signal. will push revised image and small a11y checklist to the ticket later today.
